augmented_equation: d_g=eta*rhalf_g; rho_h,aug=(1-f)rho_NFW+f(K_d*rho_NFW); M_aug=M_star+integral(rho_h,aug); insert M_aug into the unchanged spherical Jeans equation
baseline_equation: d(nu sigma_r^2)/dr + 2 beta nu sigma_r^2/r = -nu G M_base(<r)/r^2; M_base=M_star,Plummer+M_NFW

calibration.development_objective: macro mean chi2-per-bin across development galaxies
calibration.heldout_policy: freeze shared f/eta before any heldout score; no heldout row fallback

claim_boundary: Heldout applies only to shared f/eta. Heldout galaxy baseline nuisance parameters are fitted on their own public velocity-dispersion profiles. Not clean predictive proof, an independent physical validation, or evidence that Plummer is uniquely physical.
controls: half-mass-matched 3D Gaussian at frozen forced-nonzero f/eta
half-mass-matched 3D top-hat at frozen forced-nonzero f/eta
development_exception: Development scores are intentionally visible for choosing shared f/eta; heldout scores remain inaccessible until policy freeze.

development_revisions.failure: adapter f=0 path used a numerically integrated NFW mass while the fitted baseline used the analytic NFW cumulative mass; exact floor differed by 3.7e-5 to 5.6e-5 km/s and all candidate policies failed the f=0 gate
development_revisions.repair: use the exact analytic NFW cumulative mass as the base mass inside the adapter path; retain numerical convolution only for the convolved branch

fallback_rule: f=0 is permitted only as the development-selected safe policy; heldout rows are never individually replaced.
goal: Test whether one development-calibrated, galaxy-scaled 3D halo-density orthogonal adapter improves heldout spherical-Jeans velocity-dispersion fits.
operator_object: halo-only 3D NFW density; stellar tracer/mass is not convolved

primary_metric: macro mean chi2-per-bin across baseline-stable galaxies
